messages:
alex: Quick check — what exact compliance artifacts do we need to bundle for the cloud marketplace + HW SI joint listing? trying to scope asks for partners.
maria: From partnerships side: SOC 2 Type II summary + cover letter, pen-test executive summary (redacted ok) and confirmation of remedials, completed vendor questionnaire, signed integration agreement (ATO style), firmware integrity statement for any device images, and a manifest that maps each file to an owner and retention window.
samir: Security asks: full findings package (redacted PII) OR a signed assessor attestation if they refuse full disclosure. we also need the remediation timeline for any open items and the assessor contact (so we can validate origin).
liz: Ops note — please don't send raw public S3 links. use the secure-transfer portal (ShareFile) or an expiring upload link with enforced upload audit logs. include checksums (sha256) for each uploaded artifact so we can automate verification.
jordana: +1. Also require a scanned signature page from the assessor and proof of disclosure to affected customers if the pen uncovered customer-impacting issues. NDAs must be in place before we accept full reports. If partner can't sign, we accept a redacted executive summary only.
alex: Timeline: product is targeting marketplace submission next Wed. can partners get initial artifacts by EOD Mon? if not, can we accept a minimal interim bundle (soc summary + questionnaire + exec summary) and follow up with full reports during review? :eyes:
maria: i'll ping the HW integrator and SI leads now. tagging @partner-eng for schedule alignment. i'll ask for firm commitments and expected delivery times.
samir: i'll draft the artifact request checklist/email template: required filenames, checksum field, contact for signature verification, what needs redaction, and acceptable redaction rules. will share in ~2h.
marketplace-bot: Reminder — marketplace metadata requires a "compliance_bundle" field. missing or malformed bundles will block publish until resolved.
liz: preferred filenames for upload (so automation can pick them up): soc2_summary.pdf, soc2_cover_letter.pdf, pen_exec_summary.pdf, pen_full_redacted.zip, questionnaire_v2.pdf, firmware_checksums.csv, manifest.json, assessor_signature_page.pdf, assessor_contact.txt
maria: thanks liz — i'll include that naming convention in the ask. also setting retention policy: store in secure bucket for 90 days then move to long-term encrypted archive.
jordana: one more: add a short chain-of-custody log (who sent what, when) as chain_of_custody.txt — this helps with any future audit questions.
alex: perfect. maria — confirm owners and i'll route approvals with legal/product for the marketplace listing.
maria: confirmed owners (HW integrator: Mariana, SI: TechIntegrate LLC lead contact: dan@techintegrate.com). i'll start outbound messages and post status updates here.
samir: uploaded the draft email and checklist to the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/marketplace-compliance/checklist_v1.md — pls review before i send.
alex: thanks everyone — please react with :thumbsup: when you've reviewed the checklist so i can send the request to partners.
maria: will update thread tomorrow with responses. thanks!
